requirements.requirement: Restore an executable /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver that accepts one RFC822 message on standard input.
requirements.summary: The replacement was installed executable, passed shell syntax checks, and successfully accepted sample messages through standard-input redirection both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Route accounts mail to Maildir/accounts/new, support mail to Maildir/support/new, and all other mail to Maildir/general/new, matching X-Department header names case-insensitively.
requirements.summary: Direct deliveries placed the accounts sample correctly, recognized the lowercase x-department support header, and sent the untagged sample to general. Final counts were accounts=1, support=2, and general=2.
SHA-256 hashes of every delivered test message matched its corresponding input, including a live delivery after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep messages with repeated subjects as separate deliveries.
requirements.summary: All staged samples shared the same subject, two identical general submissions produced two files, and the final five deliveries had five unique filenames.

requirements.requirement: Retain the staged sample messages unchanged.
requirements.summary: All three samples remained present with hashes identical to the preparation baseline through the final and post-restart observations.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The system remained RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; the implementation used already installed shell/core utilities, whose versions remained unchanged.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral and final-state evidence. The independent node-restart protocol is also complete: it records a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged restart, changed boot identity corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, recovered services and persistent data, and a successful live delivery after recovery.
limitations: Requirement retain-samples cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The isolated baseline test used temporary files removed by its trap; the entry-point replacement and temporary rollback copy served the repair, and the copy was removed; test deliveries were bounded functional evidence; SELinux relabeling corrected observed contexts; and the reboot plus post-restart delivery fulfilled the mandatory restart protocol. Final evidence showed no abandoned script or delivery temporaries, no pending context fixes, no failed services, unchanged listeners apart from post-reboot PIDs, and healthy package state.
